label: ESP32 → OEE (Wokwi Ep 7)
info:
ChinarSoft · Industrial ESP32 with Wokwi · Episode 7
The Wokwi ESP32 publishes to MQTT; this flow turns it into rows for the Factory Monitoring 'machine' table.
1. Put YOUR device id (printed in the Wokwi serial monitor) into both MQTT nodes.
2. Set env INFLUX_TOKEN (and INFLUX_URL if not http://127.0.0.1:8181).

name: 1. Replace YOUR_ID with the id from the Wokwi serial monitor (never use + on a public broker)
